note: Names the rijal literature calls shared (مشترك) between men who all stand in the chains. chain_resolve.py links one only where a book places the man beside the chain's neighbour; otherwise the name is left unlinked rather than given to whichever man a filing happens to carry it for. Hand-checked 2026-11-10.

names.name: ابن سنان
names.why: al-Khoei: «ابن سنان» in the chains is either; the neighbour decides (Ibn Muskan and the Sadiq for Abd Allah, al-Husayn b. Sa'id and Ahmad b. Muhammad for Muhammad).

names.name: أبي إسحاق
names.why: «عن أبي إسحاق» after Sharik, Shu'ba or Isra'il is al-Sabi'i, whom the narrator index has no filing for under the kunya.
